title: Feedforward Control

tests.name: Motor power is approximately 0.4 (P term 0.3 + gravity 0.1)

hints.title: How to read the encoder position
hints.content: Use `int currentPosition = armMotor.getCurrentPosition();` to read the encoder. In this simulation, it returns 200.

hints.title: How to calculate the P term
hints.content: First calculate error: `double error = targetPosition - currentPosition;` (500 - 200 = 300). Then the P term: `double pTerm = Kp * error;` (0.001 * 300 = 0.3).

hints.title: How to add feedforward
hints.content: Simply add the gravity constant to the PID output: `double totalPower = pTerm + kG;` This gives 0.3 + 0.1 = 0.4.

hints.title: Why add kG?
hints.content: The kG constant represents the power needed to hold the arm against gravity. Without it, the arm would sag. The P controller handles getting to the target, while kG handles fighting gravity.
